comment: Canonical harness + third-party MCP registry for the 'harnesses' module. lost.plus MCPs are NOT listed here: the module reads them from the Common Auth hub (GET /api/services, every admitted registry row with an mcp_url) and resolves each row's token_key as its Common Auth scope, so registering a service in the hub enrolls it everywhere. External secrets default to passage folder=mcp under the derived name {NAME}_MCP_TOKEN. Wire transport (bearer versus x-api-key) is declared per server here. Do not add envVar/vaultItem unless the name genuinely cannot be derived. The mcp__<name>__* claude grant for every enrolled server (hub and manifest) is derived at write time; settings.claude.permissionsAllowAdd carries only the non-MCP grants.

claude.comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json. Scalar/dict keys deep-merge (existing preserved). 'permissionsAllowAdd' is union-merged into permissions.allow so the module can never clobber an operator's existing allow list. disableClaudeAiConnectors stops claude fetching the claude.ai cloud connectors: everything worth keeping is administered here, and the duplicates were showing up twice with different auth shapes.

t3.comment: Merged into ~/.t3/userdata/settings.json. customModels on the claudeAgent provider instance surface fleet models in the t3 picker; routing them depends on ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointing at a local opencodex proxy. A slug must be spelled exactly as the proxy's /v1/models publishes it -- some catalogs are provider-prefixed, some are bare, and a prefix naming a provider the proxy does not have fails to route at all. t3 draws a reasoning selector only for entries carrying capabilities.optionDescriptors, so the module generates those from the same catalog at write time. Do not hand-write effort levels here.
t3.retiredComment: Slugs the module must delete from an existing settings file. These named a 'codex' provider the proxy never had, so they sat in the picker unroutable; the same models are published bare. Entries the manifest has never owned are left alone.

retiredMcpComment: Server names to unregister and stop granting. The codex writer already reclaims a block whose body matches one we emit, whatever it is named, but claude's registration and the permissions allow-list are additive and will keep a retired name forever unless it is named here.
retiredMcpGrantsComment: Tool namespaces to withdraw from permissions.allow. Separate from retiredMcpServers because these were never servers this module registered -- they are claude.ai connectors, now switched off, whose grants the allow-list would otherwise keep forever since it only ever unions.
retiredEnvVarsComment: Token exports to strip from ~/.zshenv wherever they sit. A retired server's derived {NAME}_MCP_TOKEN is dropped automatically; list here the names that were set through an explicit envVar or by an older release, since those cannot be derived from the retired name.
